Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Round Ceramic Home Decor Flower Vase - 7 Inch, Coral White Tan
Materials: Ceramic
This uniquely beautiful vase will add a pop of color to your room, with or without a flower added. Bright coral is accented by drips of white. The bottom is left in an unfinished tan. Reactive glazing means no two are alike. 5.375"D x 5.375"W x 6.6"H Designed as a flower vase Ceramic porcelain Allow for variations in color
